verdict.summary: The Rule C2 implementation is sound as scoped: it only rejects same-source assignments for subject-star patterns with bound predicates, requires balanced nonzero per-predicate subject accounting, rejects duplicate characteristic-set keys and overflow, and declines on incomplete or unalignable evidence. Candidate/descriptor identity and pattern-permutation validation prevent summaries from being applied to the wrong source or pattern. The load-bearing tests are non-vacuous and cover the live-path prune, truncated/unknown/duplicate/overflow summaries, non-subject joins, unbound predicates, cross-source survival, candidate collapse, malformed selections, and assignment alignment. Documentation preserves the opt-in and research-grade/no-cryptographic-claim boundary.
